scope: B4-12 PostgreSQL rollback-failure rerun on the frozen B3+B4 candidate

candidate.reference: PR #298 frozen-candidate checkpoint; clean detached worktree

engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in Docker via testcontainers
assertions: A batch inserts a row, then its PostgreSQL backend is terminated during a blocking statement.
The driver reports TransactionRollbackFailed at statement index 1, with the statement and rollback failures classified as Disconnected.
The inserted row and transactional trigger-table row are absent after reconnect.
The identity sequence and trigger sequence each retain their consumed allocation after rollback.
